purpose: Materialize only explicit strategy-emitted PA alerts from the hash-pinned finalized-vintage underlying corpus; never infer alerts from descriptive diagnostics.

scan_arguments.bars: ordered daily OHLCV assembled only from bound corpus records

exact_emission_predicates: at least min_gap observed input bars have elapsed since the preceding emitted alert
h_leg_count over the strict-prior h_lookback window is at least min_h_legs
ema_distance_norm is strictly less than ema_threshold
authoritative_strategy.explicitness_rule: A corpus row is an alert if and only if the authoritative scan returns a PASignal at that row's exact bar position. No other field or rule may create an alert.

research_source_assessment.finding: The research identifies the underlying signal layer as an alert rather than an execution signal, but it is not used to infer or modify the authoritative H2-bottom predicates.

forbidden_as_alert_inputs: score_today direction votes or direction verdicts

bar_materialization.cutoff_rule: The daily bar timestamp and every contributing source timestamp must be less than or equal to decision_ts_utc.
bar_materialization.missing_data: Omit a missing corpus decision without fill, proxy, interpolation, resampling, cadence substitution, or raw-source recovery. min_gap counts observed bound daily bars. A product with fewer than 31 valid bars emits no alerts.
bar_materialization.future_row: reject the complete input before strategy scan

alert_identity_and_direction.direction_semantics: The literal PASignal pattern and direction emitted by the authoritative strategy. It is an underlying PA alert only, not an option-side instruction or trade decision.
alert_identity_and_direction.deduplication: Any duplicate alert identity rejects the complete output.

no_lookahead_rejection_tests: Reject a changed byte in the input corpus, its contract, or either authoritative source file.
Reject an input record, daily bar, or contributing maximum source timestamp after decision_ts_utc.
Prove that appending any post-cutoff record cannot change alerts at or before the cutoff.
Prove expanding-prefix equivalence: each emitted alert through a cutoff equals a scan of only the prefix through that cutoff.
Reject duplicate or non-monotonic product/decision keys.
Reject any attempt to use descriptive D/W/60/15 diagnostics or signals as an alert predicate.
Reject any strategy output whose pattern or direction is not the literal h2_bottom/long pair.
Reject option, premium, Feitian/DD-line, Greeks, DTE, bid/ask, modeled-price, outcome, performance, tuning, M7, M8, or execution fields.
limitations: The source corpus is retrospective_finalized and does not prove the bytes observable at each historical decision.
Missing source decisions remain missing; no raw data is reopened to repair them.
The corpus contains only explicit daily H2-bottom PA alerts for AU and AG; it does not claim complete PA, top/bearish, divergence, bare-K, DD-line, or Feitian coverage.
An alert starts observation only and does not authorize option selection, confirmation, evaluation, performance inference, or execution.

promotion.next_gate: Verify and consume this hash-pinned explicit alert corpus only as the alert input to a separately frozen bare-K protocol; per-unit membership and an authentic bare-K or DD-line definition remain separate blockers.
